programme_verifier.scope: schema and identity binding only; not a native geometry, oracle-mathematics, topology, STEP-consumer or capability checker

fixture_registry_guard.reason: MC-009 specifies records and attacks; it does not pre-empt the MC-011..014 fixture owners by fabricating physical fixtures.

binding_requirements: fixture records bind domain plus stock/tool/setup/history identities, physical witness, exact parameters, request/profile/accuracy, oracle independence, generator and expected authority
result records bind the exact fixture, domain, profile, accuracy, inputs, candidate source/configuration, programme checker and every explicit stage
programme verdicts bind exact fixture/result identities plus candidate source/configuration, checker, request/profile/accuracy and exported file when applicable
accepted claims require programme authority and evidence references
task outcomes remain distinct from programme/gate verdicts
binary floating values are forbidden in canonical binding objects; owning exact numeric contracts provide exact strings/integers
boundary_controls: timeout remains INCOMPLETE even when prior stage records say PASS
explicit physically valid empty material may PASS only when every required binding/stage passes
independent control fixtures may omit an F01-F16 family mapping without changing the mandatory F01-F16 denominator
